summary.name: thunderdome-top-centre-tail-300-v4
summary.correction: LED paths start at side/pentagon centre, follow labels 24..1, end at the top-centre pentagon; remaining 2m tail hangs from that top centre.
summary.route_model: red SVG/draw.io 24..1 path converted to a local route ending at top-centre, then rotated five-fold
summary.segment_length_model: uniform per half using README totals: 24-13 = 13.8m, 12-1 = 14.2m
summary.tail_policy_all_led_map: tail/extra 67 LEDs per string have raw top-down x/y at centre and are nudged around centre only for WLED uniqueness
summary.important_caveat: The all-LED map cannot represent the physical top-down overlap of the hanging tail exactly because WLED ledmap cells hold a single LED index. Raw positions preserve the true overlap; exported all-LED map uses nearest-empty-cell nudging around centre.
